text: cyclo[3.1.1]heptane (β-pinene). C10H16 = 136.2. CAS — 80-56-8 (α-pinene); 127-91-3 (β-pinene). Profile Pinene is a terpene constituent of turpentine oil (p.2406) and many other essential oils and has been used in preparations for biliary-tract, urinary-tract, and other disorders. It exists as 2 iso- mers, α-pinene and β-pinene (nopinene, norpinene, terbenthene, terebenthene).
